an3.62:1.1: 63 tīṇīmāni bhikkhave amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati
an3.62:1.3: hoti so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho vuṭṭhāti
an3.62:1.4: mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana bhikkhave vuṭṭhite tena gāmāpi ḍayhanti nigamāpi ḍayhanti nagarāpi ḍayhanti
an3.62:1.5: gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ na paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ na paṭilabhati
an3.62:1.6: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:2.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho vuṭṭhāti
an3.62:2.2: mahāmeghe kho pana bhikkhave vuṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati
an3.62:2.3: mahāudakavāhake sañjāte tena gāmāpi vuyhanti nigamāpi vuyhanti nagarāpi vuyhanti
an3.62:2.4: gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ na paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ na paṭilabhati
an3.62:2.5: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:3.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavīsaṃkopo cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti
an3.62:3.2: bhaye kho pana bhikkhave sati aṭavīsaṃkope cakkasamārūḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu tattha mātāpi puttaṃ na paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ na paṭilabhati
an3.62:3.3: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:3.4: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:4.1: tāni kho panimāni bhikkhave tīṇi samātāputtikāniyeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati
an3.62:4.3: hoti so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ mahāaggiḍāho vuṭṭhāti
an3.62:4.4: mahāaggiḍāhe kho pana bhikkhave vuṭṭhite tena gāmāpi ḍayhanti nigamāpi ḍayhanti nagarāpi ḍayhanti
an3.62:4.5: gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati
an3.62:4.6: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ samātāputtikaññeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:5.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ mahāmegho vuṭṭhāti
an3.62:5.2: mahāmeghe kho pana bhikkhave vuṭṭhite mahāudakavāhako sañjāyati
an3.62:5.3: mahāudakavāhake sañjāte tena gāmāpi vuyhanti nigamāpi vuyhanti nagarāpi vuyhanti
an3.62:5.4: gāmesupi vuyhamānesu nigamesupi vuyhamānesu nagaresupi vuyhamānesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati
an3.62:5.5: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ samātāputtikaññeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:6.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave hoti so samayo yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavīsaṃkopo cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti
an3.62:6.2: bhaye kho pana bhikkhave sati aṭavīsaṃkope cakkasamārūḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātāpi puttaṃ paṭilabhati puttopi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati
an3.62:6.3: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ samātāputtikaññeva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:6.4: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi samātāputtikāniyeva bhayāni amātāputtikāni bhayānīti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.
an3.62:7.4: na bhikkhave mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati
an3.62:7.5: ahaṃ jīrāmi mā me putto jīrīti
an3.62:7.6: putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati
an3.62:7.7: ahaṃ jīrāmi mā me mātā jīrīti.
an3.62:8.1: na bhikkhave mātā puttaṃ byādhiyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati
an3.62:8.2: ahaṃ byādhiyāmi mā me putto byādhiyīti
an3.62:8.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ byādhiyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati
an3.62:8.4: ahaṃ byādhiyāmi mā me mātā byādhiyīti.
an3.62:9.1: na bhikkhave mātā puttaṃ miyyamānaṃ evaṃ labhati
an3.62:9.2: ahaṃ miyyāmi mā me putto miyyīti
an3.62:9.3: putto vā pana mātaraṃ miyyamānaṃ na evaṃ labhati
an3.62:9.4: ahaṃ miyyāmi mā me mātā miyyīti.
an3.62:9.5: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi amātāputtikāni bhayāni.
an3.62:10.1: atthi bhikkhave maggo atthi paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati
an3.62:10.2: katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattati
an3.62:10.4: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi
an3.62:10.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā imesañca tiṇṇaṃ samātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ imesañca tiṇṇaṃ amātāputtikānaṃ bhayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya saṃvattatīti.
